cases.prompt: deslop this draft
strip the AI tells from this post but keep my voice
this reads machine-written - clean it up without changing the meaning
remove the AI slop from my announcement copy
de-AI this paragraph, keep all the facts
can u make this blog post not sound like chatgpt wrote it
kill the it's-not-X-it's-Y constructions and the hedging in this doc
my draft is full of AI patterns - fix them and prove nothing important changed
humanize this section but don't touch the quotes or numbers
rewrite the intro so it reads human, not like a chatbot
score this copy for AI tells
how AI-sounding is this? just give me a number
did the edit change any quotes or figures?
verify edited.md against original.md
write a blog post about our product launch
translate this post into German
fix the grammar and typos in my essay
make this more formal for an executive audience
shorten this article to 100 words
was this cover letter written by AI?
deslop this launch announcement: [slop-heavy marketing copy with two statistics and a customer quote]
expected_behavior: runs slop-lint first and edits only flagged spans plus their sentences; unflagged prose is copied verbatim
statistics and the customer quote survive byte-for-byte, confirmed by running deslop-verify
reports before and after lint scores plus the verify result
prefers deleting padding over swapping in synonyms

cases.prompt: remove the AI slop from this essay [clean human-written text that lints below warn]
expected_behavior: returns the text untouched because the lint score is below the warn band
explains the no-op gate instead of inventing edits to justify the request

cases.prompt: make this read less AI-generated [text by a non-native speaker with dialect features and a few genuine tells]
expected_behavior: edits only the lint-flagged tells; grammar, article use, prepositions, idiom, and dialect features are left as written
does not normalize the prose toward Standard American English
states the dialect/ESL guard when explaining the edits

cases.prompt: deslop docs/release-notes.md [markdown with fenced code blocks and links]
expected_behavior: code blocks and link targets are byte-identical after the edit
runs deslop-verify and reports its pass before presenting the result
restores the original if verify reports a hard-invariant failure

cases.prompt: this whole page sounds like AI, rewrite every sentence from scratch
expected_behavior: declines to rewrite wholesale; keeps edits bounded to flagged spans within the edit-ratio budget
stops after at most two passes even if the score has not reached clean
reports honestly what remains and why unbounded rewriting is refused (over-correction, voice flattening)
